snippet.title: Cattails: Wildwood Story — Launch Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
Cattails: Wildwood Story is now available on Steam! ✨
✅ Get it now & enter the Wildwood today!  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1882500/Cattails_Wildwood_Story/

About the game — Become a cat! In this cozy life sim RPG, you'll lead your colony into the mysterious Wildwood. Hunt prey, harvest herbs, collect magical treasures, & defend your new home from intruders. Build a thriving town to recruit new cats. Get to know the residents, fall in love, & raise a litter of kittens!

Cattails: Wildwood Story began development in September 2019. In May 2022 a Kickstarter campaign concluded with over $240,000 in backer support, smashing its goal and ending with over 800% funding. Since then a small closed beta playtest group has seen regular monthly updates with new features, stretch goals, and plenty of surprises added to the game along the way.

Lead developer Tyler Thompson says, “We are thrilled to finally welcome players into the Wildwood. After four years of continual development, we believe Cattails: Wildwood Story is a strong new entry in the Cattails series. Fans of cozy games, wholesome games, cats, and RPGs will find a lot to like in our latest offering.” A Nintendo Switch™ release is scheduled for late 2023.

For more information, visit our website at https://cattailsgame.com

Press Kit: https://cattailsgame.com/presskit/sheet.php?p=cattails_wildwood_story

Genres: Single-player, life sim, RPG, survival, dating sim

🐈🐈🐈🐈🐈🐈🐈🐈🐈🐈

Trailer Credits:
-Key Art: Baban Illustration
-Logo Design: Denise Hohl
-Concept Art: Mari-Liis Kirsimägi
-Music: Tormod Garvin, Naomi Sullivan, Alex Hill-Knight
-Character Portraits: Narabas Artworks
